vb_textbox.text: There will be two types of gnomes, with pointy shroom hats and with flat shroom hats. I found that throughout the game which type of gnomes collect more shrooms changes periodically. Therefore I'd suggest that once you've found a larger batch, say eight or nine mushrooms in one collection, with one of the gnomes, try to stick to choosing the ones with the same type of shroom hats until you find that the batch numbers are decreasing - after a while the number of shrooms will likely drop to zero or just one or two per collection. This would be a good time to go for the gnome wearing the other type of hat and see if they collect a larger number or shrooms. It's possible that they will, in which case stick with choosing that same hat type until the mushroom numbers decrease again per collection, then try choosing the other type gnomes wearing the other types of shroom hats and see if they are luckier. It's also possible that there will be a type of dry spell, where both types of gnomes will only collect very small numbers or no mushrooms at all. In that case just keep alternating your choices until you find one that starts collecting more mushrooms again and stick to that until the numbers decrease again, then try the other gnomes and so on until the game finishes. Good luck!
